hints: Combine the logarithmic terms on one side: $\ln(x - 5) + \ln x = 7$.
Apply the logarithm product law $\ln A + \ln B = \ln(AB)$ and exponentiate both sides to clear the logarithm.
Form the quadratic equation $x^2 - 5x - \mathrm{e}^7 = 0$ and solve for $x > 5$ using the quadratic formula.
walkthrough:
Collect all logarithmic terms on the left-hand side of the equation:
$$\ln(x - 5) + \ln x = 7$$

Apply the product law of logarithms $\ln A + \ln B = \ln(AB)$:
$$\ln[x(x - 5)] = 7$$

Exponentiate both sides with base $\mathrm{e}$ to remove the logarithm:
$$\mathrm{e}^{\ln[x(x - 5)]} = \mathrm{e}^7 \implies x(x - 5) = \mathrm{e}^7$$

Expand and rearrange into standard quadratic form $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$:
$$x^2 - 5x - \mathrm{e}^7 = 0$$

Apply the quadratic formula $x = \dfrac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$ with $a = 1, b = -5, c = -\mathrm{e}^7$:
$$x = \dfrac{-(-5) \pm \sqrt{(-5)^2 - 4(1)(-\mathrm{e}^7)}}{2(1)} = \dfrac{5 \pm \sqrt{25 + 4\mathrm{e}^7}}{2}$$

Since the domain of $\ln(x - 5)$ requires $x > 5$, select the positive root:
$$x = \dfrac{5 + \sqrt{25 + 4\mathrm{e}^7}}{2}$$

Perform the arithmetic calculation step by step:
$$\mathrm{e}^7 \approx 1096.633158$$
$$4\mathrm{e}^7 \approx 4386.532634$$
$$25 + 4\mathrm{e}^7 \approx 4411.532634$$
$$\sqrt{4411.532634} \approx 66.419369$$
$$x = \dfrac{5 + 66.419369}{2} = \dfrac{71.419369}{2} = 35.70968 \dots$$

Round the final answer correct to 2 decimal places:
$$x = 35.71$$
